question: For the [TEPAH][ATA]/NPA/H2O phase change absorbent at the optimal desorption conditions, what regeneration efficiency was reached, and after five absorption-desorption cycles what remained?
rendered: According to the document, at the optimal desorption conditions (desorption temperature of 393.15 K and a duration of 80 min), the regeneration efficiency was 94.7%. After five absorption-desorption cycles, the regeneration efficiency remained at 88.6% of its initial value.
